reviews.comment:
Uno aprende cositas de cada viaje que hace y acá lleno de paraguayos que cruzan y se llevan nuestro combustible que es lo más económico que tenemos nosotros estuve en la frontera y cruzan como a comprar pan ni los miran en la aduana y yo de muchas horas de viaje y soy Argentino me pararon y me controlaron somos una maravilla entre nosotros

(Translated by Google)
You learn little things from every trip you take, and here it's full of Paraguayans who cross over and take our fuel, which is the cheapest thing we have. I was at the border and they cross like they're just going to buy bread, they don't even look at them at customs. And me, after many hours of travel and being Argentinian, they stopped me and checked me. We're wonderful among ourselves.

reviews.comment:
Las filas para cargar NAFTA son de 1 km. Permiten la compra de NAFTA para revender y está lleno de paraguayos y brasileros que cruzan la frontera porque les sale la mitad de precio, vacían los surtidores y la gente de la cuidad o los turistas deben estar en promedio 5 horas haciendo fila para cargar $1500 si tienen suerte de llegar al surtidor cuando aún queda algo de combustible

(Translated by Google)
The lines for gasoline are 1 km long. They allow the purchase of gasoline for resale, and it's full of Paraguayans and Brazilians who cross the border because it's half price. They empty the pumps, and locals and tourists have to wait an average of 5 hours in line to fill up for $1500 if they're lucky enough to get to the pump when there's still some fuel left.
